mapper.insert: insert ignore into growth_mission_progress (member_id, mission_code, biz_type, biz_id, progress_date, complete_count, reward_exp, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{missionCode}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, date(#{progressDate}), #{completeCount}, #{rewardExp}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, member_id as memberId, mission_code as missionCode, biz_type as bizType, biz_id as bizId, progress_date as progressDate, complete_count as completeCount, reward_exp as rewardExp, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from growth_mission_progress where member_id = #{memberId} order by progress_date desc, id desc limit 100
select count(*) from growth_mission_progress where member_id = #{memberId} and biz_type = 'topic_completion_clawback' and biz_id = #{topicId}

select id, member_id as memberId, mission_code as missionCode, biz_type as bizType, biz_id as bizId, progress_date as progressDate, complete_count as completeCount, reward_exp as rewardExp, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from growth_mission_progress where member_id = #{memberId} and biz_type = 'registration' and biz_id = #{registrationId} order by id for update
mapper.update: update growth_mission_progress set biz_type = 'registration_clawed', biz_id = id, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and biz_type = 'registration'
